## 4. Base rates
- Recent range: about $252 to $259 in September (09-01 to 09-11). The peak was around $280 to $284 in early August; one source puts the 52-week high at $284.02. [Pluang](https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/saham-magnificent-seven-amazon-bisa-capai-rekor-tertinggi-baru)
- Trend: the stock spiked after earnings in early August, then drifted down about 8 to 11% into September and has been trading flat to slightly weaker since.
- Typical move over this window (my own estimate, not sourced): AMZN implied volatility usually runs about 28 to 35% a year. Over roughly 20 trading days that gives a one-standard-deviation move of about 8 to 10%, or about ±$21 to $25 from $256.78. That puts the 1-sigma range at roughly $233 to $280 and 2-sigma at roughly $210 to $305.
- How the stock has reacted to recent earnings: Jul 30 +15.3%, Apr 29 +0.8%, Feb 5 -5.6%. [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/35808643/options-data-tells-us-where-amazon-stock-could-be-headed-next-after-q3-earnings)

- The only expert forecasts found are 12-month analyst targets: averages of about $323 to $327 (MarketBeat 09-04, Benzinga 09-11). These are not one-month forecasts.
- I could not find an options-implied price distribution for the 10-09 or 10-16 expiries dated before 09-14.

- 2026-09-16/17 (approximate): FOMC meeting.

- Early October: a likely Prime Big Deal Days event, and the September jobs report (around 10-02).
- Ongoing: AI capex sentiment and the earnings season for other big tech companies.
- Amazon's Q3 earnings are expected around late October, after the 10-12 resolution date, so the earnings move falls outside the window. I found no confirmed date published before 09-14.
